title: Ornette Coleman and free-form playing
summary: Dance asks about avant-garde players like Ornette Coleman and Sun Ra. Humes says she played with Coleman not long ago and thought he was good.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: Well listen, oh yeah, I know, I was just going to say to you, just a couple of more guys I was going to talk about. Gosh we never touched on the subject of people like Ornette Coleman, Sun Ra. Do you ever hear, listen to those things or were you ever in a concert with any of those guys or anything?

Well he plays the alto saxophone and it's very free form. So you don't really know exactly where he's at or where he's going. It's like another world, isn't it? I just thought I would mention it in case you might know. He's a very sweet guy.
Yeah, I played with him somewhere, you know, not too long ago.
Well, yeah it's been a long time ago because I played with nobody since December.
Well, I don't call that any time at all. That's nice.
